```plato

// The chromaticities of an RGB color space's three primaries and its white
// point; together they fix the space's gamut and its matrix to CIE XYZ.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Primary_color)
type RgbPrimaries
    implements IValue
{
    Red: Chromaticity;
    Green: Chromaticity;
    Blue: Chromaticity;
    White: Chromaticity;
}
```
